analysis_role: BAMBI Flight 6 cross-species/cross-domain secondary external operational-transfer stress test.

primary_findings.2s_to_2s: Forecast transfer is substantially stronger than 5s. Fixed q90 coverage is 100%, indicating a highly conservative uncertainty radius on this secondary representation. The combined warning layer is extremely sensitive but produces many false alerts; RED alerts remain much more selective and precise.
primary_findings.2s_to_5s: Long-horizon forecast and uncertainty transfer degrade strongly. Fixed q90 coverage is severely below nominal, so the 5s uncertainty-assisted warning layer must not be described as 90%-calibrated. Combined alerts retain high event sensitivity but RED urgent-event sensitivity is modest.

critical_nonclaims: BAMBI Flight 6 is red-deer/human dominated and is not elephant-specific validation.
The analysis is a secondary operational-transfer stress test, not a pristine confirmatory uncertainty holdout.
The Flight-6 50 degree FOVY is an assumed/default reference-pipeline value, not independently measured calibration.
Virtual geofences are normalized synthetic boundaries, not real village/farm boundaries.
Response thresholds are scenario assumptions, not measured field-team response times.
No BAMBI q recalibration, model tuning, threshold tuning, persistence tuning, or response-threshold tuning was performed.
The 5s q90 uncertainty layer is not calibrated on this secondary representation.
